description.text: Program Description Material forming and control engineering is the study of plastic molding and hot working change material microstructure and macro properties and surface shape in the process of the relevant technological factors on the influence of the material, solve the molding process development, molding equipment, process optimization theory and methods; The die design theory and method are studied, and the materials, heat treatment and processing methods are studied. Intership Including military training, metalworking, electrical and electronic practice, cognition practice, production practice, social practice, course design, graduation design (paper), etc., shall generally be arranged more than 40 weeks. Duration 4 years

duration.text: The Materials Processing and Control Engineering at Beihang University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3472 USD/per year ￥ 25000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record.

requirements.text: 1.Applicants are expected to study hard, observe the Chinese laws and the regulations of BUAA and have the equivalent of a high school education. 2.Applicants are expected to have good scores and studied hard in high school. 3.Applicants should attend the entrance examination and meet the requirements of BUAA.
